text:
Maya: Draft for the field sales cheat-sheet ready. Goal: give SDRs + AEs a 1-pager that compares Hosted / Dedicated / Private for security, SLA, onboarding steps, and who to loop in.
Raj: Nice. Can you add recommended trial criteria + 2-3 benchmark callouts? Need something to rebut 'we can't host in cloud'.
Sam (Demand Gen): Also want a short headline for webinar signups. 'Fast, predictable LLM inference for regulated apps' maybe?
Maya: Draft snippet: 'Redwood Inference: unified runtime across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments — SLAs, KMS integrations, and predictable throughput.' Thoughts?
Lin (Content): Shorten to 'Unified inference with enterprise SLAs & private deployment options.' Add 1-tab benchmark: latency @ p95, cost per 1k tokens, and recommended device (A100/Tr4).
Raj: For field, include migration path: PoC on Hosted -> Dedicated for scale -> Private for compliance.
Maya: Agree. We'll include a 3-row table in the one-pager (Primary value, Typical customer, Onboarding time).
ops-bot: Link to draft saved: https://internal.redwood/sales/briefs/security-slas-1970001111-draft.md
Sam: Webinar angle: 20-min product demo + 10-min customer case (HIPAA fintech). CTA: 'Book a migration workshop'.
Lin: Need an objection handling blurb: encryption at rest & transit + optional HSM + SOC2 + audit logs.
Raj: Also include fallback/resilience: multi-region routing, model variant fallback, and canary rollouts.
Maya: I'll assemble the one-pager and a 30s social post. Target ship EOD Thu. @Raj can you review before Friday?
Raj: Yep, review by Friday 11am PT.
Sam: I'll seed the webinar landing with the benchmark narrative — will need the p95 numbers from eng-ml.
eng-ml-bot: pinging @ashok for p95 latency numbers for ultrafast workload (512 tokens). Ashok?
Ashok: p95 hosted ~120ms/token on tr4 (with batching), dedicated ~80ms/token on a100, private depends on infra but baseline ~85-100ms.
Maya: Perfect. We'll use hosted: 120ms p95 (512 toks), dedicated: 80ms p95. Cost callout: example workload ~ $0.12 per 1k tokens hosted vs $0.06 dedicated (approx).
Lin: Okay to include benchmark narrative sentence: 'In our internal e2e test, dedicated deployments reduced p95 latency by ~33% and halved per-token servicing cost vs hosted.'
Raj: Keep wording careful: 'internal benchmark; results vary by model and workload.'
Maya: Draft path: produce 1-pager PDF + short field email + webinar outline + 1-slide benchmark graphic.
Sam: I'll schedule webinar tentatively for next Wed. Will coordinate AEs for invites.
Maya: Thanks team — I'll drop the draft in #marketing and ping here when ready :thumbsup:
